digest.component_or_area: rebar reconciler binding store baseline persistence
propositions: Baseline fields stored as vendor dicts (ADF, Jira field objects) can be normalized to scalar strings (description text, exact Jira name strings for status/priority) for ~66% size reduction while preserving live comparison equivalence through the existing inbound mapper canonicalization seam.

Assignee field must remain as a complete vendor dict to preserve identity form preservation and suppress concurrent remote edits via _assignee_matches logic; collapsing to a scalar would break inbound-direction suppression.

The projection helper applied only at baseline write is idempotent and accepts both raw vendor dicts and pre-normalized scalars, enabling safe rollback and dual-shape reader support without comparator changes.

All three assignee identity forms (email, accountId, displayName) must preserve their raw dict structure unchanged across baseline writes to maintain suppression behavior and prevent local-wins overwrites.
